newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine C. Bank sells dlrs at 29.40/29.70.
newsitem.headline: Philippine C. Bank sells dlrs at 29.40/29.70.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank sold dollars at 29.40 to 29.70 pesos on Tuesday, traders said.
The sales, however, were in limited amounts of $500,000 each to selected banks, they said.
"Buyers of dollars still outnumber sellers in the market," a foreign bank dealer said.
The peso traded in the range of 30/29.40 in morning deals, with volume thin at $18.5 million.
Traders said the limited participation of the central bank in the market had forced banks to source their dollars from commercial transactions to service clients' needs.
"There's a huge unfilled demand for dollars," another said, since the central bank announced on Friday it would loosen its grip on the peso so it would move to a market-determined level.
The central bank had hoped speculation would end with its new exchange rate policy.
